text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series—
A sport and entertainment spectacle made up
of Umamusume races and Winning Lives.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The main pillar is the race. Only the winner of the race is permitted to stand center stage for the live performance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Races are run on turf and dirt.
Short, mile, medium, and long distances.
And every racecourse has its own unique track.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"However, they all share one thing in common.
Whoever crosses the finish line first is the winner—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Every Umamusume strives to be the fastest.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"To run faster than anyone, faster than anything that exists in this world.
That is my dream."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Among them, she was aiming for the pinnacle.
Seeking not just victory in races, but pure speed."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"A speed that surpasses even light itself.
That is the absolute pinnacle of speed I strive for."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Since I was born as an Umamusume,
I want to run faster than anyone else in the world."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This is the tale of an Umamusume of unwavering conviction,
who endlessly pursues pure speed alone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Challenge for Top Speed

      ~Umamusume Sprint Climax: The Eve~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is Calstone Light O.
I asked her what inspired her to pursue running at maximum speed.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"My parents. Once they chose a path,
they pursued it relentlessly and saw it through to the end."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing that, I thought I wanted to grow into
an adult just like my parents."

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Is there anything about your parents that particularly stands out to you?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: They look so happy when they're working. My father is a prosecutor, and my mother is a researcher. Both of them have sparkling eyes whenever they work.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: My father is at his most lively when heading to court armed with irrefutable evidence. My mother, when she secures her research funding.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her father's figure, relentlessly pursuing truth and upholding justice.
Her mother's figure, taking on the romantic quest of unraveling the unknown.
She thought to herself that she wanted to grow up to be like them.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
When did you first start wanting
to run fast?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I don't remember.
I was fast for as long as I can remember.
That's why I wanted to run faster than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Faster than who I was yesterday. Faster than who I am right now.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I want to always run the fastest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That is top speed—
The speed Calstone Light O continues to pursue.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She met someone who would support that dream.
That person taught her the technique to run faster and guided her to the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: What was your first impression of your Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I thought you had quite a lot of nerve.
Showing up late so boldly, even as a rookie Trainer.
choice_data_list: Did you really have to bring that up...?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Shall we pretend it never happened?
Then my first impression is of a spaced-out person
having their bag snatched.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was no need to mince words.
Their ability to speak their minds openly
showed the deep trust they shared with their Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A race where she aims for top speed, working hand-in-hand with her Trainer. There, she clashes with her rivals.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Believe and Durandal.
They're fellow Umamusume at Tracen Academy
and Calstone Light O's classmates."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: "Calstone-san, Durandal-san. It seems you have yet to turn in your math homework..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my apologies. It slipped my mind.
I will take it to the faculty room myself later.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I would feel terrible troubling you
over a mistake of my own making.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
As for Light O-san—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I forgot it.
I'll go grab it right now!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ? Aren't you going to get it yourself?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'm going. That's why I'm booking train tickets.
Running all the way back to my parents' house would be a bit much, even for me.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Your family's place?!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I forgot it when I went back home over the weekend.
Trying to finish it early backfired on me, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
There's no way you can go get it now!
The next class is about to start!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: If you're going to pick it up, do it over the weekend!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Couldn't you just have it sent by mail?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For a while after winning her debut race, Believe endured a difficult period of struggle without any victories.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, once her running style is perfected, she will display overwhelming strength.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her greatest strength is sustaining top speed.
With an artisan-like stride that never relents to the end,
she's clashed with Calstone Light O for the title of fastest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, Durandal.
Her true strength is—an unknown quantity.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And one more.
The legendary sprinter, Sakura Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: You cannot speak of the fastest Umamusume while overlooking her—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
And... that's a commercial.
I guess the second half is Bakushin O-san's segment?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Everything from my interview was included.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Wait, my scene ends here?
I was just making a fuss with Light O-san!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
They could at least show some race footage.
What do they mean, "her ability is unknown"...?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I wonder if Grandpa and the others were watching...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Very well. I shall make them realize through results.
Next time, I will make them beg to do a feature on me.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
Only by conquering both the spring and autumn sprint GⅠs can one truly be the fastest sprinter.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: We won't settle this with just the Ibis Summer Dash.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Even so... Right O really ought to thank the narrator.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Why?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It was completely full of misleading phrasing, wasn't it?
Good thing the narration tied it all together nicely, but still...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it looks like it's being well received on Umatter.
"Calstone Light O's answers are hilarious every time."
"Her personality really stands out, doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Your persona is getting more attention
than your actual running, you know.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
There are comments about her running and her Trainer, too.
'So fast! She wasn't kidding when she bragged about top speed.'
'Just wanting to run fast—what a classic Umamusume dream.'

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Daitaku Helios and her Trainer are in total sync."
"Like Umamusume, like Trainer."
"I'm worried about that Trainer's performance review."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help but feel
a little sympathetic towards you, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O's declaration of war drew so much attention that a special program featuring her and Calstone Light O was produced.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once that program aired,
public interest in the Ibis Summer Dash and the two of them soared even higher.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-senpai is running the Ibis Summer Dash, huh!
A straight course definitely catches one's eye!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah. It's all about how fast you can run! Competing for that in a race sounds like so much fun.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Running at top speed on a straight course, huh...
You just want to try it at least once.
Even knowing how difficult it is.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Free from any concern of honor or prestige. Seeking pure speed alone...
It is truly free, and yet feels so completely natural."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~, exciting!
The speed you feel on the straightaways!
It reminds me of the French breeze.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Me too!
I'm debating whether to increase my storyboard pace!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Japanese turf is so easy to build up speed on! I feel like I can run much faster here than in France!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're so right!
If you run in Japan, setting a world record isn't just a dream!

text_block_list.name: Special Feature Viewer A
text_block_list.text:
You know, I was really captivated by
that phrase "top speed" Calstone Light O mentioned.

text_block_list.name: Special Feature Viewer A
text_block_list.text:
Just how fast is the 'ultimately fast' Umamusume?
How fast can someone truly become?

text_block_list.name: Special Feature Viewer B
text_block_list.text:
"They're already faster than us humans as it is, so I can't even begin to imagine.
That speed is on a whole other level!"

text_block_list.name: Special Feature Viewer A
text_block_list.text:
I feel like Calstone Light O
is going to show us the answer!

text_block_list.name: Special Feature Viewer B
text_block_list.text:
You're right! "Top speed" sounds super awesome!
Fufu, an unknown realm of speed, huh? It's so full of dreams!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: It's strange, isn't it? Even though it's my dream, it feels as if it's everyone's dream as well.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I'm glad.
That will be a great source of strength to push me forward.”

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"The Ibis Summer Dash is a straight course.
It's the race where we can aim for absolute top speed the most."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I'll pour everything I've cultivated over this past year into this.
choice_data_list: We still have... a year left, right?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Indeed. There is no ceiling to top speed.
Let's go as far as we can!
